method: SGLang production PyNccl versus frozen hybrid RoCEnante. BF16 input reset plus in-place SUM, 16 operations per CUDA graph, four replays per event interval, four ABBA blocks per changing seed, three seeds. Report raw GPU microseconds per operation including identical source copies; no serving throughput claim.
qualification: 27 random shape/dtype/seed cases per rank, each in-place and out-of-place, bit-exact fixed-rank FP32 oracle; nine signed dyadic cases; 24 mixed-shape graph replays. Largest tested BF16 payload is 491,520 bytes.
limitations: No model resident; these are component timings, not end-to-end throughput.
NCCL BF16 reduction rounds differently, about 0.004 relative L2 against the FP32 oracle; full-model output can differ.
The original benchmark attempt aliased its FP32 oracle accumulator to rank-0 input and failed before timing. V2 clones the accumulator; raw failure retained.
